title: Brookfield consortium - proposed acquisition of Asciano Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
Former proposed decision date of 17 December 2015 delayed at the request of Brookfield.
ACCC commenced market inquiries on proposed s87B undertakings.
Closing date for submissions relating to the proposed s87B undertakings.
Former proposed decision date of 18 February 2016 delayed to allow for provision of further information from Brookfield and consideration of revised s87B undertakings.
Asciano announced a potential acquisition by a consortium including both Brookfield and Qube Holdings Limited. ACCC timeline suspended.

Following an announcement by Asciano that it had entered into a new binding agreement with Brookfield, Qube and others, the ACCC discontinued this review. The ACCC commenced a review of the new joint proposal to acquire Asciano on 30 March 2016.
